claim: Recent observed demand was the strongest overall forecast benchmark in this synthetic oncology market.
Patient and market signals were useful for event-regime analysis and scenario planning.
Forecast Information Set governance prevented ordinary forecast models from using unavailable future information.
Scenario outputs were traceable from access, epidemiology, competition, persistence, and supply assumptions to demand.
Hybrid XGBoost beat all simpler methods across all horizons.
The synthetic case study proves real-world oncology demand behavior.
The model is clinically validated or ready for production deployment.
